shared_elements: shallow low-relief carving on the broad face of an upright monolithic shaft
curved, band-like relief elements crossing the shaft
limbs rendered as thin raised outlines (arms/hands in A, animal legs in B)
justification: Both show schematic, very shallow relief motifs laid onto the flat face of a tall upright shaft, with thin raised outlines describing limb-like forms and curving bands, which gives a broadly comparable carving convention. But the subject matter differs fundamentally: A depicts an anthropomorphic figure with a carved head, facial features, arms folded to a belt and disc/circle motifs, while B depicts a quadruped animal in profile above a smaller elongated creature, with no human figure, head or disc at all.
